description_for_human: Build production-ready React apps and components with AI. Agent-optimized with AX scoring, SEO, and structured data.
description_for_model: AINative Builder generates React/Next.js web applications from natural language prompts. It produces agent-accessible HTML with semantic structure, ARIA labels, data-agent attributes, JSON-LD structured data, and AX (Agent Experience) optimization. Use this to build dashboards, landing pages, e-commerce stores, admin panels, chat interfaces, and agent monitoring dashboards.
